Container.Name: finmeta
Container.Overview:
Jellyfin-native metadata, artwork and overlay manager -- a self-hosted alternative to Kometa that reads and writes metadata, posters and overlays directly against your Jellyfin library. No Plex required.
On first run the web UI starts in dry-run mode with no password set -- open it, finish setup, and point it at your Jellyfin server before enabling writes.
Container.Description: Jellyfin-native metadata, artwork and overlay manager -- a self-hosted alternative to Kometa that reads and writes metadata, posters and overlays directly against your Jellyfin library. No Plex required.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Finmeta web UI listens on.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Finmeta's own config.yml, auth DB and run history.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin media library. Must match the path_mappings entry you set in Finmeta's config.yml -- set this before enabling writes.

Config.Name: Kometa import (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, read-only: point at an existing Kometa install to import its config/packs from the Finmeta UI without granting write access to it. Leave blank if unused.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, used for scheduled jobs (e.g. poster rotation).

Config.Name: FINMETA_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Encrypts stored provider API keys at rest. Generate one with: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))" -- leave blank to let Finmeta generate and persist one on first run.

Config.Name: FINMETA_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to 1 once Finmeta is served behind HTTPS (e.g. via a reverse proxy). Leave blank otherwise.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: your Jellyfin API key. Can also be entered later from the Finmeta web UI instead.
